question: Does the canonical point-in-time feature contract remain defensible predictively, and does the complete Lead Quality -> Inventory -> LOS -> fallback system remain decision-ready when all final metrics are generated from the same canonical OOF population?
primary_change: replace historical Lead Quality OOF input with OOF predictions trained directly on the canonical E016 point-in-time ABTs

scoring_time.T2: second and later inquiry_at before conversion is already observable

validation.strategy: four-fold rolling-origin temporal CV by lead cohort
validation.lead_integrity: all snapshots for one lead remain in the same partition

feature_benchmark.calibration: Platt scaling fit on each fold validation set by stage

error_analysis.operational_gate: top 15% within fold and T1/T2 stage

rules: ABTs rebuilt from data/candidate through E016
mutable current-state Spot leakage fields blocked
metrics ranked inside fold/stage before aggregation
